documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Corporate Announcement U/R 29(1)(A) Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 Read With SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015 Regarding Intimation Of Holding The 3/2026-27 Board Meeting Scheduled To Be Held On Friday, 13Th Day Of November, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Syncom Formulations (India) Limited submitted its 38th Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, reporting standalone total income of Rs. 51,753.92 lakhs and net profit after tax of Rs. 7,600.80 lakhs. Management recommended a final dividend of 10% (Rs. 0.10 per equity share) for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that global medicine spending continues an upward trajectory with total pharmaceutical spending projected to exceed USD 2.3 trillion by 2028, supported by a CAGR of 5-8%.
demand_outlook.quote: In 2024, global medicine spending continued its upward trajectory, reecting a growing demand for chronic care, specialty treatments and innovative therapies. Total pharmaceutical spending remains on course to exceed US$ 2.3 Trillion by 2028, supported by a projected CAGR of 5–8%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that volume growth is expected to grow at an average rate of 2.3% through 2028 driven by emerging markets.
demand_outlook.quote: While volume growth plateaued in 2023, it is expected to grow at an average rate of 2.3% through 2028, driven by emerging markets such as China, India, Southeast Asia and Latin America.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that the Indian pharmaceutical market is projected to see strong medicine spending growth reaching USD 38-42 Billion by 2028 with a CAGR of 7-10% from 2024 to 2028.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s pharmaceutical market is projected to see strong growth, with medicine spending expected to reach US$ 38-42 Billion by 2028, with a CAGR of 7–10% from 2024 to 2028.

margins_costs.claim: The company noted that pricing regulations on drugs brought under the National List of Essential Medicines impact revenue potential and profit margins.
margins_costs.quote: Regulatory Price Controls: The pharmaceutical industry faces challenges from pricing regulations on drugs brought under the National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM). This impacts revenue potential and prot margins.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of directors recommended a dividend of Rs. 0.10 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of Rs. 0.10 per equity share, (i.e., 10% on the face value of Rs. 1/- each), for the financial year 2025-26, subject to the approval of the Members at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has not recommended any dividend on equity shares for the financial year 2024-25 in view to conserve resources.
capital_allocation.quote: In view to conserve resources, the Board has not recommended any dividend on Equity shares for the Financial Year 2024-25.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that heavy tariff increases announced by the US in July and August 2025 could severely impact the export front.
risks_headwinds.quote: The heavy increase in tariffs and penalty announced by the US in July/August, 2025 the resulting for export in US market may be highly disappointed and may have adverse effect on the export front of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that global geopolitical tensions and rising raw material costs have disrupted supply chains and increased cost volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain vulnerabilities: Global geopolitical tensions and rising raw material costs have disrupted supply chains. These challenges are further intensied by input cost uctuations and price volatility in essential materials, which could impact procurement stability and increase manufacturing costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company cited potential disruption from proposed US tariffs, including a 200% tariff on pharmaceutical imports.
risks_headwinds.quote: Critically, the Indian pharmaceutical industry faces potential disruption from proposed tariffs, including a 200% tariff on pharmaceutical imports by the US, which is India's largest drug importer (accounting for nearly 33% of India's pharma exports in FY2024).

management_commitments.claim: Shri Ankit Kedarmal Bankda was appointed as Executive Chairman and Whole-time Director for a period of 3 years effective August 9, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: appointment of Shri Ankit Kedarmal Bankda (DIN: 02359461) as the Executive Chairman and Whole-time Director of the Company, for a period of 3 (Three) years w.e.f. 9 th August, 2025

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
